Alright so basically, I've made two attempts at hosting servers so far. The first was a modded Valhalla server which ended up having about five regular players, and the second was a modded 'The Center' map with about five regulars as well.

[Here is the Steam Group I made for the server I was hosting.](http://steamcommunity.com/groups/PrehistoricTragedy) I write a bit about why I'm hosting a server and a gist of the server settings I'm interested in. More or less looking for higher multipliers than on Vanilla, but without going too crazy. I've always used mods that extend the wild dino level limit, the first Valhalla server I hosted had wild dinosaurs up to level 1020, when I played on The Center I had them spawning in up to 240.

I've since become interested in the [Annunaki Genesis](http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=538986229) which if you're unfamiliar with it adds "Elite" and "Badass" versions of most dinosaurs. Elite Dodos and Dilos are rideable and slightly more powerful than non elite versions. "Badass" creatures have one of several buffs, some are firebreathing, others are poison inducing, some have an Ice aura... They add a lot of variation into the game. It also spawns wild dinosaurs up to level 600.

So this time around I want to try and get a group of people interested before I actually fork up the cash to host a server. The last couple times the server simply never gained traction, only ever had a few people on at a time. Hosting servers is time consuming, and not all that enjoyable if there's hardly anyone joining up lol. I've never advertised outside of Steam or Voat, don't really advertise much on Steam either, trying to find a slightly more mature audience haha.

Anyways I'm familiar with hosting, have used HostHavoc in the past, familiar with the commands and able to update quickly most of the time to avoid downtime. Downtime from mods updating is a big issue with modded Ark. Steam handles workshop mod updates, so whenever a mod author updates, if your Steam is open it'll update that mod for you automatically, however servers have to be updated manually. This leads to a certain amount of "mod version errors" due to players often having the updated mods much sooner than servers. ( And with no options for players to revert to older versions. )

If any of this interests you, hit me up, I can get the server up and running anytime really, I just want to know that there will be at least five or so people interested in actually playing. If anyone here has any suggestions for forms of advertisement that won't attract a bunch of tools I'm listening!

edit; It's worth noting that Annunaki adds a significant amount more content than just the Elite and Badass variations, I just didn't want to spend half the post talking about Annunaki. It also adds "Champion" and "Apex" versions of some dinosaurs, changes the whole Alpha system around so that there are Prime Alphas as well as regular Alphas. They make the regular Alphas tameable and act as end game content, the primals are even stronger than your average Alpha. There are also "Wardens" which are incredibly strong and larger versions of a few dinosaurs, acting as "Warden of the Ocean" and "Warden of the Sky" etc etc. It's an impressive mod with a lot of content added.
Anyone interested in setting up an Ark server with me, running Annunaki and a few other mods on "The Island" map?
